risk_note: RV2 (db/migrations; attribution evidence). Migration 0025 adds app.union_binding_conflicts (30151 conflict log): app_id, user_id, platform, union_account_id, kind (occupied / cooling / rebind), occurred_at, resolved_at, resolution (bound_active / already_active); named CHECKs for kind, resolution and platform; resolved_at and resolution both null or both set, resolved_at >= occurred_at; no database clock defaults; composite FK (app_id, platform, union_account_id) -> union_accounts(app_id, platform, id); partial index on unresolved rows and a time-point index (app_id, user_id, platform, occurred_at); couli_app SELECT, INSERT and column UPDATE (resolved_at, resolution) only, a trigger rejects other rewrites, re-resolving and DELETE; couli_readonly SELECT. tools/ci/lint-migrations.test.ts gains one funds-set line (the union_ prefix already protects the table; tightening only, ledger #374). Generated schema views through the test machine. Written by hand.
